summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or code, per instructions. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with coordinates computed by removing the padding offset; docstrings updated; set_rnd skips names starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator wrapping iter_patch with copy-back off; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take patch_iter, transform, and with_coordinates, with worker splitting via np.ceil, per-patch transform via apply_transform, and the exact len() NotImplementedError; PatchDataset docstring uses dtype=float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array (single-process and two-worker blocks using the spec's pinned values), and an extra test_missing_len. Caveats: the spec did not give the contents of the two 1x4x4 test images, so I used np.arange(16) for both; the pinned values are unverified against that input and the tests may fail until run. Lines I edited are within 120 columns; pre-existing long docstring lines in get_valid_patch_size were left alone. Nothing was committed.
